The MRE is based on exploration and drilling conducted by or on behalf of Água Azul S.A. and incorporates 453 drill holes totaling approximately 74,365 m of drilling, including approximately 59,000 m in 362 drill holes at Abelhas, approximately 5,200 m in 35 drill holes at Juliano and approximately 10,100 m in 56 drill holes at Campos Altos. ValOre has not conducted drilling at the Água Azul Project as of the date of this news release.

The Água Azul Project is located in the municipality of Água Azul do Norte, southeastern Pará State, Brazil, within the Carajás Mineral Province. It comprises four contiguous mineral tenure areas covering approximately 20,608 ha, consisting of one Mining Concession covering 6,494 ha and three Exploration Permits covering 14,114 ha, currently held by Água Azul S.A..

The project is approximately 7 km from Água Azul do Norte and is accessible via paved highways and secondary roads. Existing infrastructure includes a processing plant, grid power connection, water supply and tailings management systems, workshops, accommodation and operational support facilities. The PEA contemplates expansion and modernization of this infrastructure to support the proposed processing expansion.

The property encompasses the Abelhas-Juliano exploration area in the central and eastern portions and Campos Altos to the west. Modern exploration began at Abelhas-Juliano in 2012 and at Campos Altos in 2022, with geochemical sampling, geophysical surveys and drilling conducted by or on behalf of Água Azul S.A.. Gold production at Abelhas commenced in 2023.

As security for the Deferred Payments, ValOre has agreed to grant to the Seller at closing fiduciary assignments (alienação fiduciária) governed by Brazilian law over 51% of Água Azul S.A.'s total and voting share capital and 49% of LandCo's total and voting share capital (the "

Under the Fiduciary Assignments, ValOre will transfer to the Seller resolvable title (propriedade fiduciária resolúvel) to the encumbered shares, which will be released upon payment in full of the Deferred Payments (including through the exercise of the Prepayment Option). For as long as no enforcement event has occurred, ValOre will retain the right to exercise all rights attached to the encumbered shares, including voting rights. The Fiduciary Assignments also operate as binding voting agreements under Brazilian corporate law, pursuant to which ValOre has agreed not to approve certain matters in respect of Água Azul S.A. and LandCo without the Seller's prior consent, including, among others: (i) incurring indebtedness for borrowed money that would increase aggregate indebtedness to BRL 1 million or more (BRL 100,000 in the case of LandCo); (ii) acquiring or disposing of assets above certain thresholds and, in any case, disposing of any mining rights or rural properties; and (iii) paying dividends or other distributions, unless certain minimum cash balances are maintained. If ValOre fails to pay any Deferred Payment and such failure is not cured within five business days following written notice from the Seller, the full outstanding balance of the Purchase Price will become immediately due and payable, and the Seller will be entitled to enforce the Fiduciary Assignments, including through the judicial or extrajudicial sale of the encumbered shares. The Fiduciary Assignments may also be enforced upon certain other material breaches by ValOre that remain uncured for five business days following written notice. In ValOre's discretion, it may substitute the Fiduciary Assignments with an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee issued by any of Santander, Itaú Unibanco, Banco Bradesco or BTG Pactual.

Drill-hole collars at the Água Azul Project were surveyed using high-precision GNSS/RTK equipment, and downhole surveys were used to record changes in azimuth and inclination. Diamond drill core was logged and photographed, and mineralized core was generally sampled over 0.3 m to 1.0 m intervals, with half-core retained and half submitted for analysis under documented chain-of-custody procedures. Samples were prepared by SGS Geosol in Parauapebas, Pará, and analyzed in Vespasiano, Minas Gerais, with gold determined by fire assay with an atomic absorption finish. ALS Chemex was used as an independent check laboratory. QA/QC procedures included the insertion of blanks, duplicates and certified reference materials. The QPs verified the underlying data through site inspections by Messrs. Soares and Moreira and independent desktop reviews, including reviews of drilling and analytical databases, QA/QC results, geological and Mineral Resource models, metallurgical testwork, engineering studies and economic assumptions. Variability in duplicate sample results and isolated exceedances in certified reference material analyses were identified but, in the QPs' opinion, do not materially compromise the reliability of the analytical database for the purposes of the current MRE. The QPs consider the data and verification work completed adequate for the purposes of the MRE and PEA. Further details regarding data verification and its limitations are provided in Sections 3 and 12 of the Technical Report.

This news release refers to cash costs per ounce and AISC per ounce of gold, which are non-GAAP financial measures that do not have a standardized meaning under IFRS Accounting Standards and may not be comparable to similar measures presented by other issuers. As the proposed expansion of the Água Azul Project is at the PEA stage, these measures are forward-looking estimates derived from the PEA mine plan and cost model, not from historical operating results. Cash costs include estimated mining, processing and site general and administrative costs, royalties and selling costs. AISC includes cash costs plus sustaining capital expenditures and closure costs. Both measures are divided by total payable gold ounces over the LOM and exclude acquisition costs, expansion capital and corporate general and administrative expenses. The Company believes these measures provide investors with a useful indication of the expected cost of producing gold at the Água Azul Project. They should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for measures prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards.
